title: 模型检测
Model check
cost: 最多发送 6 次合成测试请求，计入模型用量。
Up to 6 synthetic requests. Model usage applies.
IDLE: 填写对话页地址后开始。
Enter the chat page URL to start.
LOGIN: Sign in in the browser window.
WAITING_CHAT: 请在浏览器中登录；登录后发送一条测试消息。
Sign in, then send one test message.
WAITING_MESSAGE: 登录后，发送一条不含业务信息的测试消息。
After sign-in, send one message without business data.
WAITING_REPLY: Waiting for the current reply to finish…
TESTING: 正在检测，请保留测试浏览器窗口。
Checking. Keep the test browser open.
ADAPTER_REQUIRED: 已识别网页封装接口，待适配后继续检测。
A custom chat API was found. An adapter is needed to continue.
STOPPED: 已停止，测试浏览器数据已清理。
PROFILE_RETAINED: 已停止。浏览器数据未清理，请关闭测试窗口后再次点击停止。
Stopped. Close the test browser and click Stop again to remove its data.
BROWSER_NOT_FOUND: 未找到 Edge 或 Chrome，请先安装浏览器。
Edge or Chrome was not found. Install a browser first.
BROWSER_DEBUG_UNAVAILABLE: 无法连接测试浏览器。请检查浏览器是否允许自动化调试。
Cannot connect to the test browser. Check its automation policy.
BROWSER_DISCONNECTED: 测试浏览器已关闭，请重新开始。
The test browser closed. Start again.
INVALID_PAGE_ADDRESS: 请输入完整的 http:// 或 https:// 页面地址。
Enter a complete http:// or https:// page URL.
LOCAL_OPERATION_FAILED: 操作未完成，请停止后重试。
The operation failed. Stop and try again.
TEST_TIMEOUT: 检测超时，请停止后重试。
The check timed out. Stop and retry.
AUTH_ADDRESS_EMPTY: 请先填写统一认证地址。
PAGE_OPERATION_FAILED: The page is navigating. Please wait…
BROWSER_COMMAND_FAILED: The page is navigating. Please wait…
BROWSER_COMMAND_TIMEOUT: 浏览器响应超时，请停止后重试。
The browser timed out. Stop and retry.
AUTH_REQUIRED: 登录已失效，请重新登录。
RESPONSE_OR_NETWORK_ERROR: 请求或响应未通过校验。
The request or response could not be verified.
PAGE_TEST_FAILED: The page check did not complete.
CUSTOM_ADAPTER_REQUIRED: 接口信息已保存，需适配网页专用协议。
Interface details saved. A custom protocol adapter is needed.
BROWSER_DATA_IN_USE: 请先关闭测试窗口并点击停止，清理上次数据。
Close the test browser and click Stop to clean up the previous session.
